items.exampleEn: My boss paid for lunch as a treat for the whole team.
items.exampleZh: 我老闆請整個團隊吃午餐，當作一種款待。

items.exampleEn: The server brought us our menus and suggested the special of the day.
items.exampleZh: 服務員送來菜單，並推薦了當日的特選。

items.exampleEn: We went to a small pub after the meeting and had a few drinks.
items.exampleZh: 開會後我們去了一家小酒館喝了几杯。

items.exampleEn: The restaurant had a festive atmosphere with red decorations and music.
items.exampleZh: 餐廳佈置了紅色裝飾和音樂，充滿節慶氣氛。

items.exampleEn: I made a booking for two at the restaurant for Saturday night.
items.exampleZh: 我預約了週六晚上的餐廳，兩位。

items.exampleEn: I ordered from a takeaway place because I was in a hurry.
items.exampleZh: 我很趕時間，所以從外賣店下了單。

items.exampleEn: The office offers free refreshments in the break room every afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 辦公室每個下午都在茶水間提供免費茶點。

items.exampleEn: This buffet restaurant is self-service, so you get your food from the counter.
items.exampleZh: 這家自助餐餐廳是自助式的，你要從櫃檯自己取餐。

items.sentenceEn: Could I have a table booking for four people at seven o'clock, please?
items.sentenceZh: 請問可以幫我們預約四人座位嗎？七點。

items.audioEn: We're having a festive dinner to celebrate the company's tenth anniversary. I've already made the booking and ordered the cake.
items.audioZh: 我們正在舉行一場喜慶的晚宴，慶祝公司成立十週年。我已預約好了，也訂了蛋糕。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼要舉行這場晚宴？
options: To send off a retiring manager

items.sentenceEn: I'd like to make a booking for six at the restaurant on Friday evening.
items.sentenceZh: 我想預約週五晚上餐廳的六個座位。

items.sentenceEn: The pub serves local beers and has a festive atmosphere every weekend.
items.sentenceZh: 那家酒館供應當地啤酒，每個週末都有喜慶的氣氛。

items.stemEn: My boss said lunch was on him — it was a ____ for the whole team.
items.stemZh: 我老闆說午餐他請客——這是整個團隊的款待。

items.stemEn: The conference room had ____ ready for everyone during the long meeting.
items.stemZh: 長會議期間，會議室為每個人準備了茶點。

items.passageEn: Last month, our department held a festive dinner to celebrate the launch of our new product. Our manager made the booking for a large restaurant near the office. The restaurant is self-service, so guests picked their food from the counter. There were many dishes to choose from. After dinner, we moved to a small pub across the street. The pub had live music and served local beers. Everyone enjoyed the evening. Some colleagues who could not attend ordered takeaway from a nearby shop instead. The manager said the treat was well worth it.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們部門舉辦了一場喜慶的晚宴，慶祝新產品上市。經理幫我們在辦公室附近的一家大型餐廳訂了位。那間餐廳是自助式的，所以客人從櫃檯自己取餐。菜色很多，大家可以自由選擇。晚餐後，我們轉到街對面的一間小酒館。酒館有現場音樂，也供應當地啤酒。大家都玩得很開心。有些同事因為無法參加，就從附近的外賣店點了外賣。經理說這趟款待非常值得。

options: 辦公室附近的大型自助餐廳

questions.questionZh: 為什麼有些同事吃了外賣？
options: 他們比較喜歡外賣店的食物

items.promptZh: 我幫團隊預約了餐廳，週五晚上七點，八個位子。
referenceEn: I made a booking for the team at the restaurant for eight people at seven on Friday.
I made a booking for eight at the restaurant on Friday at seven for our team.
rubricZh: 正確使用 booking 表示預約
時間（週五、七點）和人數（八位）表達正確
介詞使用正確（for, at, on）

items.instructionZh: 用 refreshments 寫一個句子，描述辦公室或會議中的情境。
referenceEn: The company provides free refreshments in the meeting room.
We set up refreshments for the visitors in the lobby.
Could you prepare some refreshments for the afternoon meeting?
rubricZh: 句子語法完整、結構正確
情境合理（辦公室或會議場域）
